items_flat.title_en: FT: residual-value guarantees hide up to $300B of AI infrastructure exposure
items_flat.title_zh: FT：殘值保證使最高約 3,000 億美元 AI 基礎建設曝險難見於資產負債表
items_flat.summary_en: The Financial Times reported that technology firms have offered as much as $300 billion of residual-value guarantees over the past year to back AI data-center and chip financing through special-purpose vehicles. Coverage of the investigation says Meta used the structure on its Hyperion project, Broadcom took on about $29 billion of exposure tied to chips for Anthropic, and Nvidia provided about $105 billion in guarantees linked to a SoftBank energy data-center build for OpenAI. Because the debt sits primarily at the SPV, most of the contingent exposure does not initially appear as ordinary corporate debt.
items_flat.summary_zh: 《金融時報》報導，科技公司過去一年提供最高約 3,000 億美元殘值保證，透過特殊目的實體為 AI 資料中心與晶片融資背書。後續整理指出 Meta 在 Hyperion 專案使用此結構、Broadcom 承擔約 290 億美元與 Anthropic 晶片相關曝險、Nvidia 則為服務 OpenAI 的軟銀能源資料中心提供約 1,050 億美元保證。債務主要落在 SPV，多數或有曝險起初不會以一般公司債呈現。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is not a model launch, but it is how frontier capacity is being paid for: demand and residual-value risk are shifted into contingent guarantees that appear late, if at all, as conventional debt. What remains unverified in public filings is how often those floors would actually be called if utilization or chip resale values disappoint.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這不是模型發布，而是前沿算力如何被付錢：需求與殘值風險被轉成或有保證，未必即時以一般負債入帳。公開財報仍難核實：若使用率或晶片轉售價值不如預期，這些下限保證實際被觸發的頻率有多高。

items_flat.title_en: Nvidia posts Jensen Huang CBS Sunday remarks: speed and safeguards ‘aren’t at odds’
items_flat.title_zh: Nvidia 官方轉發黃仁勳 CBS 訪談：加速與安全「並不對立」
items_flat.summary_en: Nvidia’s official account posted a CBS Sunday clip of CEO Jensen Huang arguing that moving fast on AI and building safely are compatible if testing, monitoring, and safeguards run in parallel. The company linked an extended interview on CBS News covering fears about AI.
items_flat.summary_zh: Nvidia 官方帳號轉發 CBS Sunday 片段，執行長黃仁勳主張：只要測試、監控與防護同步進行，AI 加速與安全可以並行。公司並附上 CBS News 延長訪談，討論外界對 AI 的疑慮。
items_flat.analysis_en: The clip is messaging, not a product or capital-commitment change. It lands in the same 24-hour window as reporting on large Nvidia-linked infrastructure guarantees, so the public line on safety sits next to a financing story about contingent exposure rather than replacing it.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是對外表述，不是產品或資本承諾變更。它與同一日有關 Nvidia 相關基礎建設保證的報導重疊，安全論述與或有曝險融資故事並列，並未互相取代。
items_flat.quote: Moving fast and building safely aren’t at odds. AI should move as fast as we can, with rigorous testing, monitoring, and safeguards every step of the way.
items_flat.quote_zh: 加速與安全並不對立。AI 應盡可能快，同時在每一步做嚴謹測試、監控與防護。

brief_en: Sunday was a financing-and-messaging day, not a model-launch day. The FT reported up to $300B of residual-value guarantees backing AI data-center and chip SPVs. Nvidia posted Jensen Huang’s CBS Sunday remarks that speed and safeguards can run in parallel. No tracked lab shipped a new named model in the latest window.
brief_zh: 週日是融資與對外表述日，而非模型發布日。FT 報導科技業過去一年以殘值保證支撐最高約 3,000 億美元 AI 機房與晶片融資。Nvidia 官方轉發黃仁勳 CBS 訪談：加速與安全可並行。最近時段無追蹤實驗室發布新命名模型。
